items.cn: 这座塔的高度超过一百米。

items.en: Accurate measurement is important in science experiments.
items.cn: 准确的测量在科学实验中很重要。

items.en: The recipe needs a small quantity of salt.
items.cn: 这个食谱需要少量盐。

items.en: The width of the river changes with the season.
items.cn: 河的宽度随季节变化。

items.en: Accuracy matters when you record experimental results.
items.cn: 记录实验结果时，准确性很重要。

items.en: Consistency is the key to learning a language.
items.cn: 坚持是学语言的关键。

items.en: The durability of the shoes makes them good for hiking.
items.cn: 这双鞋很耐穿，适合徒步。

items.en: Yoga improves both strength and flexibility.
items.cn: 瑜伽能增强力量和柔韧性。

items.en: The purity of the water is tested every week.
items.cn: 水质纯度每周都要检测。

items.en: Sleep quality affects your mood and memory.
items.cn: 睡眠质量会影响情绪和记忆。

items.en: The reliability of the internet is important for online exams.
items.cn: 网络可靠性对在线考试很重要。

items.en: The school has high standards for lab safety.
items.cn: 学校对实验室安全有很高标准。

items.en: Finishing the marathon was a real accomplishment.
items.cn: 跑完马拉松是一项真正的成就。

items.en: Winning the debate was a team achievement.
items.cn: 赢得辩论赛是团队的成就。

items.en: Technology advancement creates new kinds of jobs.
items.cn: 技术进步创造了新的职业。

items.en: The completion of the project took three months.
items.cn: 完成这个项目花了三个月。

items.en: Volunteering gives her a sense of fulfillment.
items.cn: 志愿服务给她带来满足感。

items.en: Daily practice leads to steady improvement.
items.cn: 每天练习会带来稳步提高。

items.en: Success is not only about grades.
items.cn: 成功不只是成绩。

items.en: The victorious team thanked their coach.
items.cn: 获胜的队伍感谢了教练。

items.en: Learning to manage time is a challenge for many students.
items.cn: 学会管理时间对很多学生来说是个挑战。

items.en: She faced many difficulties but never stopped trying.
items.cn: 她遇到很多困难，但从未停止尝试。

items.en: The school started an investigation into the broken window.
items.cn: 学校开始调查窗户被打破的事。

items.en: The class meeting focused on environmental issues.
items.cn: 班会聚焦环境问题。

items.en: They found a peaceful resolution to the argument.
items.cn: 他们找到了和平解决争吵的办法。

items.en: Talking openly is often the best solution.
items.cn: 坦诚沟通往往是最好的解决办法。

items.en: Solving problems with friends is easier than facing them alone.
items.cn: 和朋友一起解决问题比独自面对容易。

items.en: He had trouble sleeping before the big exam.
items.cn: 大考前他睡不好觉。

items.en: Please fill in the form before you join the school club.
items.cn: 参加学校社团前，请先填好这张表。

items.en: The school sports meeting will take place next Friday.
items.cn: 学校运动会将在下周五举行。

items.en: Do not give up when a problem looks difficult.
items.cn: 遇到难题时不要放弃。

items.en: The teacher promised to look into the noise problem.
items.cn: 老师答应调查噪音问题。

items.en: People say I take after my mother because we both love reading.
items.cn: 大家说我和妈妈很像，因为我们都爱读书。

items.en: We finally worked out a plan for the class project.
items.cn: 我们终于想出了班级项目的方案。

items.en: Let us go over the notes before the quiz.
items.cn: 小测前我们一起复习笔记吧。

items.en: Can you come up with a better name for our club?
items.cn: 你能给社团想一个更好的名字吗？

items.en: Good study habits can spread quickly in a positive class.
items.cn: 好的学习习惯会在积极的班级里迅速传播。

items.en: I cannot put up with the noise from the street at night.
items.cn: 我实在受不了晚上街上的噪音。

items.en: Perseverance helped her improve her English step by step.
items.cn: 坚持让她一步步提高了英语。

items.en: Taking responsibility for your choices is part of growing up.
items.cn: 为自己的选择负责是成长的一部分。

items.en: A strong foundation in math makes later topics easier.
items.cn: 扎实的数学基础让后面的内容更容易。

items.en: Climate change is a global challenge.
items.cn: 气候变化是全球性挑战。

items.en: Reading is a lifelong habit worth building.
items.cn: 阅读是值得培养的终身习惯。

items.en: We need sustainable ways to use energy and water.
items.cn: 我们需要可持续地使用能源和水。

items.en: Students must adapt to new ways of learning.
items.cn: 学生必须适应新的学习方式。

items.en: Mutual respect makes group work more enjoyable.
items.cn: 相互尊重让小组合作更愉快。
